name: Kasuga Minori
source:
She is a bright and active beautiful girl. She is the student body president and a member of the cheerleading club.

She commutes to her school in Tokyo by train every morning.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/choumanin/index.html]official site[/url]]
